---
form: free-verse
syllables: 8.6.8.6
scheme: xaxa
---
The morning breaks upon the hill
And wakes the sleeping town
The river runs with silver light
Where all the shadows drown

The farmer walks the dewy field
The bells begin to ring
And all the birds in all the trees
Lift up their wings to sing

O grant the bread for all the days
And peace for all the night
And teach the hands to build the good and true
And keep the lamps alight

Now let the day be done in peace
The work be laid aside
And let the sleepers rest again
Where all the hopes abide
